rawContent: And in a ceremony full of discussion about #MeToo and fighting to bring an end to gendered abuse, the award for Best Actor in a Drama goes to the man accused of beating and choking his ex wife. #GoldenGlobes #GoldenGlobes2018

The #MeToo movement has given courage to women in every industry to speak up about gendered violence at work, and that is incredible.
I hope the brave women at Sovereign Hill get the justice they deserve. https://t.co/Wh6oTzAuYi

When politicians (on ALL sides of politics) stay silent about the behavior of MPs like Barnaby Joyce, I can't help but think its because they all have skeletons in their closet. 
I guarantee it won't be long until #MeToo stories are unearthed from the halls of Parliament.

It's interesting that the #MeToo movement has not managed to bring down any abusers whose victims have been wives or girlfriends. 

Johnny Depp, Bill, Murray, Gary Oldman, Chris Brown, Sean Penn - despite well documented abuse, these mens careers are still untouchable. https://t.co/2lbD4GLPAp
P.S. This is a criticism of the mainstream media and our misogynistic society broadly - NOT a criticism of the #MeToo movement which has shone a light on gendered violence of all kinds.

I just cant help but notice that domestic/family violence is still viewed as a grey area, or a 'private' matter whose perpetrators are often viewed sympathetically - as though violence is sometimes understandable when love/jealousy/passion is involved. #MeToo

Remember the time Gary Oldman choked his wife and hit her with a telephone as she tried to dial the police, in front of their children? 
Is the establishment too uncomfortable to call out men whose victims were wives/girlfriends orrrr...?  #Oscars #MeToo

I wish men were as outraged when their sporting heroes abuse women as they are when they participate in cheating. 

How dare @smh compare  #cricketcrisis to the #MeToo movement?! Completely trivialises the horror of sexual assault.

"The reason that Jacinta Ardern interview got to me is that we've ALL had that moment of being blindsided by sexual harassment when we're just doing our job" - 
@WeFightForFair Women's breakfast discussing #MeToo

Glad to hear an audience member ask about how to create REAL diversity in political representation, given 1/4 Australians come from a non English speaking background. 👌
We cant leave women of colour behind in discussions on affirmative action. 
#MeToo @WeFightForFair breakfast
